questions: Were you fully conscious and aware while you were on the ground?
Did you lose control or strength in your muscles immediately before collapsing?
Were the episodes triggered by laughter, joking, surprise, anger, excitement, or another strong emotion?
Did the weakness affect your knees, legs, face, jaw, neck, or arms?
Could you choose when to lie down or resist the collapse?
Did you recover your normal strength within a few minutes without confusion?
Have you had excessive daytime sleepiness or unintentionally fallen asleep during the day?
Have you experienced sleep paralysis or vivid dream-like hallucinations while falling asleep or waking?
Did you feel lightheaded, faint, have blurred vision, nausea, sweating, or a racing heartbeat before collapsing?
Did you completely black out at any point?
Did the episodes occur during exertion or shortly after standing up?
Did anyone observe jerking, stiffening, tongue biting, or loss of bladder control?
Were you confused, unusually sleepy, or weak after the episodes?
Have you had similar episodes while sitting or lying down?
Have you recently started or changed any medication, alcohol, or recreational drug use?
Have you ever been diagnosed with heart disease, an abnormal heart rhythm, epilepsy, or narcolepsy?
